observations.body: A reluctant boast exposes what Corinth tolerates. I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little. To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.
